_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only a 5% base rate of ±2+ point moves in 12h windows this is a statistical coil, so HOLD is the honest default while the accumulation thesis needs confirmation that fear is exhausting, not just pausing.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both see constructive accumulation setup, but analyst explicitly calls HOLD direction while narrative implies eventual UP without committing to timing.
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed drops below 20 with btc_momentum_30d holding above 45 and funding staying below 0.01%
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows collapse below 70 while DXY breaks above 101 and funding spikes above 0.015%
